Author: AktOn1
Name: Sphere Player
Punchline: Town, battle and boss music from the Final Fantasies you choose.
Description: Plays music from the original Final Fantasy I to XVI soundtracks (YouTube, shown in a small video window) and switches it by what you are doing in game: town, field, dungeon, battle, boss. Turn the game's own music down and let this take over. On first start it downloads a Chromium based player (about 160 MB).
CommandHelpMessage: /sphere opens the music window. /sphere help lists all commands.
